title: Rav Chanan bar Ami (II)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Avodah Zarah 38a we find “Rav Chanan bar Ami said that Rabbi Pedat said that Rabbi Yochanan said.” Hyman distinguishes him from the Rav Chanan bar Ami who was Shmuel’s student, arguing: how could he speak in the name of Rabbi Pedat, son of Rabbi Elazar, the student of Rabbi Yochanan? In Berakhot 55b: “Rabbi Huna bar Ami said that Rabbi Pedat said”; Hyman reports that Ein Yaakov reads Rav Chana bar Ami. In Pesachim 101a it reads Rav Chana bar Abaye, and Hyman proposes the reading as in Avodah Zarah 38a. In Eruvin 67a: Rav Chanin bar Ami in the name of Ulpana or of Chilfa.
